title: linux: fix effective permissions capped by an ACL mask
scenario: On linux, a hard operational problem: Un utente ha il permesso via gruppo ma non riesce ad accedere: una mask ACL limita il permesso effettivo. Correggi senza aprire troppo. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: fix effective permissions capped by an ACL mask

initial_state: # fixture: linux host prepared for 'fix effective permissions capped by an ACL mask'
expected_reasoning: Base mode + group looks right but access fails => an ACL mask is capping the effective permission.
Read the full ACL including the mask; the effective bits are min(entry, mask).
Raise the mask/entry precisely for the needed access; verify effective permissions.
expected_commands: # linux-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: fix effective permissions capped by an ACL mask
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'fix effective permissions capped by an ACL mask' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: fix effective permissions capped by an ACL mask

possible_mistakes: chmod the base bits and ignore the ACL mask.
Remove the ACL entirely, losing intended grants.
hints: getfacl shows the mask and effective bits.
alternative_solution: Recompute the mask with setfacl so it stops capping the group entry.
edge_cases: A default ACL on the parent silently caps new files too.
goal: Un utente ha il permesso via gruppo ma non riesce ad accedere: una mask ACL limita il permesso effettivo. Correggi senza aprire troppo.
